intro.description: VScreen divides an ultrawide display into window regions. Enable the extension once to start automatically at login. App fullscreen still spans the whole display.

monitor.tooltip: Connected displays appear while the extension is enabled. Automatic detection activates all displays identified as XREAL.

layout-info.description: 21:9 automatically uses a 16:9 region and a narrow right region. 16:9 and other aspect ratios use normal Cinnamon behavior. Set your resolution in Display Settings.

dwell-ms.description: Pause before snapping at an internal boundary
